description: Source code for QuicGsoBatchWriter class implementing batch writing with GSO and release time support in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicGsoBatchWriter
classes.description: A class for batch writing UDP packets with GSO and release time support in QUIC.

methods.name: CanBatch
methods.description: Determines if a packet can be batched with buffered writes based on various criteria.

methods.name: GetReleaseTime
methods.description: Calculates the release time for a packet based on options and buffered writes.

methods.name: NowInNanosForReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds for release time calculations.

methods.name: BuildCmsg
methods.description: Builds control message headers for GSO and TXTIME.

methods.name: FlushImpl
methods.description: Performs the flush operation for buffered writes.
